title: A Vow for the Postcard
author: Mirabel Vasquez
blurb: Paloma Ashgrove, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
